ValidationRule.description: Cannot move backwards in opportunity stages. Applies to Partner opportunities.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: (CASE( StageName , "Introduction",1, "Needs Analysis",2, "Benefits Presentation",3, "Committed",4, "Engaged",5, "Closed Won",6, "Closed Lost",6,0) < CASE(PRIORVALUE(StageName) , "Introduction",1, "Needs Analysis",2, "Benefits Presentation",3, "Committed",4, "Engaged",5, "Closed Won",6, "Closed Lost",6,0)) && RecordTypeId = "0121a000000RMUC"
